title: Contraction Analysis of Time-Delay Systems
summary: In this paper, we investigate contraction analysis for nonlinear time-delay systems described by functional differential equations. We first extend the concept of Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals within the differential framework. We then show that its existence is equivalent to that of an incremental Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and guarantees uniform incremental exponential stability. Next, we extend the concept of Lyapunov-Razumikhin functions within the differential framework, whose existence also ensures uniform incremental exponential stability.
